direction: Use a dimensionless radial feature with a narrow effect on near-ties.
hypothesis: Separating distance normalization from capacity gating may make the feature interpretable and avoid overpowering geographic savings.

operations.mechanism: Preserve the incumbent score and route-start logic. Normalize radial change by a distance scale such as the two depot radii, rather than by vehicle capacity. Use capacity only to modulate the bounded coefficient. Prefer a small near-tie adjustment.

preserve: Keep the existing CVRP interface, read-only inputs, feasibility and deterministic evaluation. Preserve useful incumbent structure unless the mechanism calls for a deliberate pivot.
reasoning_summary: The best radial variant retained the incumbent formula and multiplied by a small factor containing radial distance divided by remaining capacity. It scored 11.14047, unchanged on four instances and worse on 3 and 5; the other variant scored 12.44891. Use the selected complete in-run Memory record as advisory context.
